newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee consumers buy for first half 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee consumers buy for first half 1997.

text.p: Steady coffee futures losses amid trade and commission house selling and weaker sentiment supported German roaster buying for the first six months of 1997, traders said on Friday.
Spot purchases focused on Brazil arabicas, where supplies were readily available and differentials favourable.
Centralamerican differentials also dropped relative to Colombians, Kenyans and Tanzanians.
Robusta levels dropped towards the end of the week amid supply pressure, but roaster interest was limited. Arabicas were down $6-9 per 50 kg fob on the week and robustas off $3.
